review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, design self-review; not independent approval
review.decision: Retain recorded operation intent and target identity in shared Activity without fabricating calls
review.notes: Reconstruction from the retained reviewed five-case design and display fixtures; the prior uncommitted temporary source and patch are unavailable after reboot, so no byte-for-byte recovery is claimed. Fresh base is 1c7b84e02ed8f21024fb2be5e8ba4ebb38c17422. User lifted the old build hold; normal isolated Go/RN/browser gates are enabled under a 5GiB task budget and 2GiB free floor. Commit this sealed reviewed design before new test edits. Preserve recorded operation/raw input/ref/status and real call count. Optional bounded action and subject_count require explicit known method/complete typed input or native parsed read targets, never shell text/result guesses, file discovery or skill execution. One exec reading several files remains one real call. Shared presenter feeds App/browser/Trace for all five adapters. No live input, restore, TCC, App/service restart or deployment in these source tests. Author self-review is not independent approval; existing source/failed evidence and other candidates remain untouched.

cases.description: Skill reading has a recorded source identity
cases.setup: Codex parsed_cmd read paths and Claude/Kimi/OpenCode/DSH-style explicit read_file/file_path or Skill arguments; canonical skills/name/SKILL.md, bare names, unrelated scripts and mixed files.
cases.action: Parse actual adapter records and replay exact-ID mirrors.
cases.expected: Only explicit skill methods or recorded read targets under a skills directory supply skill identity; no filesystem reads, frontmatter execution, shell-text guessing or claim of skill application. Mixed ordinary/skill reads remain file reads. Raw input/ref/name/status/order/count remain.

cases.description: Web operations retain search, open and find intent
cases.setup: Recorded web_search/WebSearch, WebFetch/open_url, known web.run parameter objects for search_query/open/find/click, mixed/unknown/malformed and truncated sources.
cases.action: Parse actual toolStep/provider records; inspect selected metadata and raw details.
cases.expected: Specific web labels require a known method or complete recognized action structure. Search queries are not called page navigation; find patterns are not called web searches. Mixed/unknown remain a neutral web action. No result/body/credential scanning or additional arbitrary parameter retention.

cases.description: Multiple source targets stay one real call
cases.setup: Native one exec with one/three/four read targets, duplicate basename/ID and generic function_call/native mirror order; code wrapper plus inner exec.
cases.action: Parse full and incremental sources; read scoped original input ref.
cases.expected: Recorded target count and bounded names are visible; count describes targets, not extra calls. Exact-ID merge enriches metadata without changing original input/ref or inventing records, parentage or execution success; unknown/mixed commands remain command.

cases.description: App browser and Trace share precise bilingual labels and icons
cases.setup: Same canonical action metadata for all agents, three-file call, explicit skill name and unknown/incompatible action; generated browser presenter and actual RN rows.
cases.action: Compare titles/previews/icons/raw facts and loaded-window call counts in English and Chinese.
cases.expected: Read skill/name, Search web/query, Open webpage/target and Find in page/pattern agree across surfaces; plural target label is accurate. Unknown action falls back, invalid counts ignored, original record remains unchanged. Existing mouse/touch targets and inspector raw data remain.

cases.description: Presentation stays bounded and backward compatible
cases.setup: Old payloads without action/count, large/malformed strings and mixed/unrecognized tools; explicit failed/cancelled calls and code text mentioning Skill or web.
cases.action: Generate compact previews and Trace events without executing commands or parsing results.
cases.expected: Old payloads retain useful fallback; only known explicit tool names refine old web labels. Bounds and raw fields survive; action metadata round-trips through Trace; no success claim, arbitrary decoding, file lookup or increased call counts.
